svg.title: Casio CT-S500 labelled interface
svg.desc: Original schematic of selected controls grouped by function, not a scale hardware drawing. Physical controls carry no assumed MIDI bindings. See connections.svg for the connection inventory.
svg.metadata: Symbol vocabulary: NYU ABILITY Project / IDM SynthAccess; https://github.com/IDMNYU/synthaccess/tree/ee1ef12cec3a3fb6be59a7861f7df8848be2dafe/tactileSynthGuides. Original schematic geometry; physical controls do not imply MIDI mappings.
